# telnyx_sim_card_groups (Data Source)

Lists sim card groups, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_sim_card_group`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_private_wireless_gateway_id` (String)
- `filter_wireless_blocklist_id` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `sim_card_groups` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--sim_card_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sim_card_groups`

Read-Only:

- `consumed_data` (Attributes) Represents the amount of data consumed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_groups--consumed_data))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `data_limit` (Attributes) Upper limit on the amount of data the SIM cards, within the group, can use. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_groups--data_limit))
- `default` (Boolean) Indicates whether the SIM card group is the users default group.<br/>The default group is created for the user and can not be removed.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `name` (String) A user friendly name for the SIM card group.
- `private_wireless_gateway_id` (String) The identification of the related Private Wireless Gateway resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sim_card_count` (Number) The number of SIM cards associated with the group.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
- `wireless_blocklist_id` (String) The identification of the related Wireless Blocklist resource.
